the vibration data, we segmented the signal into patches and converted each patch into an LLM
input dimension vector using value and position embeddings. Then these vectors were input into
the LLM. We extracted features by fine-tuning the Add & Layer Norm layers of LLM and
classified the data by the Layer normalization and Linear layers.
